name: Silverleaf nightshade
desc: Silverleaf nightshade (Solanum elaeagnifolium): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 58 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Solanum elaeagnifolium, the silverleaf nightshade or silver-leaved nightshade, is a species of plant in the nightshade family native to North and South America.
